title: Case 044: Window Handle Repair Request
initial_request: Opened the blind above this window this morning and the window handle fell off.... Now unable to open the window.
overview: The tenant reported that a window handle came off when they opened the blind, leaving the window at the top of the staircase unable to open. The tenant clarified which window was affected. The landlord approved sending a contractor, and Northbridge Lettings assigned Cedar Homes. The provider later reported the work complete and said an invoice was attached. The request was closed after the recorded final checks, including confirmation of key return. The referenced photo files and invoice are unavailable; their contents cannot be verified.
outcome: The provider reported that the window repair was complete and that an invoice was attached. Northbridge Lettings subsequently marked the request closed after completing its recorded checks.
